Definition: Berekjah, the name of six Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Berachiah or Berechiah = "Jehovah blesses"; 1) a son of Zerubbabel; 2) a Levite who returned for the exile; 3) father of Meshullam, one of Nehemiah's chiefs who assisted in rebuilding the walls of Jerusalem; 4) father of Zechariah; 5) a Gershonite Levite, the father of Asaph, the singer, doorkeeper of the ark; 6) an Ephraimite chief in the time of Ahaz
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
